recap.text: Prepotente appears on the recap programme in a row with Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia Mar, and Miriam Dom. Prepotente does not smile for the camera. A portal takes a province boss that Prepotente had entranced. Prepotente meets Carl and a delightful cat, then tells the woman beside Carl he could crunch her bones. Miriam strikes him with her staff and makes him apologize for wanting to murder them.

Prepotente and Miriam stack debuffs on a boss until Quan Ch walks into the plan. Prepotente puts spiders to sleep with a debuff and ranks third as a level thirty-eight Caprid. After a club revokes Miriam's membership, Prepotente lets a companion devour clerics. Prepotente and Miriam take apart a level 150 feral turkey god, and Prepotente reaches level 55.

Prepotente is a level seventy goat who swallows the Ring of Divine Suffering and uses a benefactor box to get a winged mount named Bianca. He takes over Carl's party for a day, strikes the killing blow against a boss, and claims a memorial crystal for the goddess Apito. Prepotente shatters the glass tunnels of the Great Race and keeps his mother's Boots of Kiznet's Final Flight.

Prepotente captures a giant bat in the Bahamas and takes the top spot on the list. He ignores Carl's messages except to point out typos in a transcription of a lore book. Prepotente puts four squads to sleep and tells Carl that a zombie event killed his opponents. He estimates a thirty-five percent chance of success for Carl's theory and decides not to kill Carl for letting his mother hurt herself.

Prepotente surveys the naga border and kills most of the naga army to settle a score for Miriam and the Blood Hunter program. He drinks Big Red, wears fuzzy handcuffs that do not lock, and puts sentient blood from a wall into a jar. After assisting Li Na in the woods, he informs Carl he will hug him and screams.

Prepotente is a goat who rides a Perriso named Sweety. He uses rockets to attack a Dominators' car and teaches others to collapse slag elementals with non-molten metal. He sings In the Air Tonight for a guild and carries a Memorial Crystal for Apito, which a level 250 god steals from his neck. Prepotente joins Carl's party after the god's attack.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: They have put me on their recap, the programme between floors, in a row with humans. The captions say Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia Mar. And Miriam Dom, of course, since she is the one who walked me into this place. I did not ask for the camera and I do not smile for it. If the audience wants a goat that performs, the audience can wait until I feel like singing, and then it can sit very still and listen.
beats.gist: Prepotente appears on a recap programme with humans and does not smile for the camera.

beats.headline: Deprived of my prey
beats.text: I had the province boss asleep and entranced, and I was lowering its blood pressure toward cardiac arrest. Two more hours. Its death would have blown soul crystals through the whole system and let everyone down. Instead a portal takes it, and through the hole I find Carl, a colossal dolt, and the cat. The cat is delightful; we are the only two Earth creatures left in here with true sapience. I tell the woman beside him I could crunch her bones. Miriam strikes me with her staff and has me say I am sorry I wanted to murder them.
beats.gist: Prepotente is a goat crawler who meets Carl, the cat, and Miriam.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Watch the highlights from the last floor, since they insist on replaying them. Miriam and I are stacking debuffs onto a boss, one on top of the other, timed to the second, the way it is supposed to be done and the way nobody else in this dungeon can do it. Then Quan Ch walks into the middle of it, and the plan is gone. The best work I have done in this place, and that is the part they replay.
beats.gist: Prepotente and Miriam stack debuffs on a boss until Quan Ch walks into the middle.

beats.headline: Third, above the cat
beats.text: Miriam and I scale the inside wall of our bubble. A debuff puts the spiders to sleep, and they plummet to their deaths, every one of them, and somehow that finishes the subterranean zone as well. Now we go underwater. The list is posted: third, Prepotente, Caprid, Forsaken Aerialist, level thirty-eight, four hundred thousand. Carl is second. The cat is fourth.
beats.gist: Miriam and Carl scale a bubble wall while a debuff kills spiders and finishes the subterranean zone.

beats.headline: The club revokes Miriam
beats.text: The club revokes Miriam's membership because she is a vampire now. As if that were her doing, as if any of you idiots chose what you are. So I let our third companion loose in the main lounge. It devoured a number of clerics before the rest had the sense to flee. There is a Holy Crusade Bounty on the three of us now, whatever that is supposed to mean, and the club is shut while they cleanse it.
beats.gist: Prepotente lets a companion devour clerics in a lounge after the club revokes Miriam's membership.

beats.headline: The turkey
beats.text: The feral turkey god. Level 150, tripled in size from eating what was left of another god, sitting on a popped bubble and screaming. Miriam and I take it apart with our debuffs. It gives me eight levels, which makes me 55, the highest in the dungeon, which should surprise nobody. The recap shows me gnawing the largest feather in the universe and screaming, over and over, while Miriam strokes my hair.
beats.gist: Prepotente and Miriam use debuffs to take apart a screaming, tripled-size feral turkey god.

beats.headline: He ruined my spell. Again.
beats.text: Again. He has done it again. Mother and I have been at work on a spell over that city, and now this idiot is lying at the edge of the jungle with bolts through his leg and his shoulder and a stack of debuffs. Level fifty-four. How did this idiot get so high? And what are those knife symbols over his head? Mother, you should feed on him before he dies. She will not. I say we let him die. He ruined my spell. Again. You need blood.
beats.gist: Prepotente is a level fifty-four goat crawler with bolts in his leg and shoulder.

beats.headline: Tripper, tears and a hug
beats.text: There is a line of traps at the town entrance built to decapitate anyone who comes near, and they require a special touch. I am explaining this to Carl, who cannot manage his own basic hygiene, when he casts something and sets off every trap at once. That was an attack. Negligence most serious. I prepare Bianca for battle, and he calls me by my special name, which only Mother may use. I weep into her robes. Mother says we must apologise. I apologise for calling him malodorous. Then we hug, and I scream in his ear.
beats.gist: Prepotente explains decapitation traps to Carl, who sets them off and causes Prepotente to weep.

beats.headline: He swallows the ring
beats.text: The cat's spell works, and I can move. I take the Ring of Divine Suffering off and drop it in the dirt. Then I pick it up again and swallow it. I scream at what is left of her until the sound will not come. Oh, mother, what did you do. She was going to play piano for me like she used to. She was going to sing me my special song. And now, it appears, my sponsor has sent me an emergency benefactor box.
beats.gist: Prepotente swallows the Ring of Divine Suffering and receives an emergency benefactor box.

beats.headline: Nobody responsible may exist
beats.text: A wand makes a safe space for three minutes, and I spend it opening my boxes. The legendary benefactor box holds a spray applicator and a recipe: fine healing, blessed water and a weedkiller, turned to mist. I take five potions from Carl as payment for the Size Up scrolls he stole from my mother. Then Bianca, with wings now, and a saddle. If I cannot exist in a world with my mother, nobody even remotely responsible for her death can exist in it either.
beats.gist: Prepotente uses a wand for a safe space to open a legendary benefactor box.

beats.headline: A package for the cat
beats.text: Level 70. Fifteen hunter-killer marks. Carl offers me a nap. I do not wish to rest or see his waste-of-money bathroom, and I do not wish to be involved in whatever he is planning. His idiot friends need not guard him; I wish him no harm. The floating one mentions goat recipes, so I scream in her face. Then I put the potion on the table. It came in my benefactor box. I cannot fathom why my sponsor would send me something meant for the cat. I leave.
beats.gist: Prepotente is a level 70 goat who leaves a potion for the cat on a table.

beats.headline: He asks to join Carl's party
beats.text: I inform Carl that I must join his party. He says no, naturally. I am level seventy, I would lead any party I joined, and he suggests I found my own and join the guild. It would only be for the remainder of this floor, so we travel together to the start of the next. I have been collecting the clues, and Katia has told me about the cat's magical hammer and stick. Then a voice booms from the stage and I scream. He says we are bookmarking this.
beats.gist: Prepotente asks to join Carl's party, but Carl says no.

beats.headline: Pole position, and a stage on fire
beats.text: I was the prize counter's first customer. Thirty-three hands. I walked up, pointed at the seventh floor's pole position, the skill upgrade and a case of mana potions, and took them. I did not ask what the flag does. Then the pet show. I take Bianca onto the stage and say nothing, because there is nothing to say. I scream once. She hisses. We leave, and the stage smoulders behind us and catches fire, and elves appear from nowhere to stamp out the flames.
beats.gist: Prepotente takes pole position, a skill upgrade, and mana potions, then sets a stage on fire.

beats.headline: One zap, for a day in charge
beats.text: Carl needs the potions out of his prize boxes, and there is no saferoom in the castle. I have a personal saferoom cube, and one zap left on my wand. I let him stand on the cube and use the zap, and he gets his potions out, and a great deal else. In exchange, he lets me take over his party for a day or so. When the seal breaks, I throw potion bottles into the nymphs.
beats.gist: Prepotente lets Carl use a saferoom cube and one wand zap for party control for one day.

beats.headline: Riding Bianca down
beats.text: Bianca cuts through the nymphs like a snowplow, and I am on her back, screaming, shields around me, throwing potion bottles into the fray. The queen's lightning finds Britney's butterflies instead and the blast sends Carl flying. I fly over him on Bianca. Then I jump off my mount with a bubbling potion in each hand.
beats.gist: Prepotente rides Bianca through nymphs and throws potion bottles while the queen's lightning blasts Carl.

beats.headline: Twenty-two percent
beats.text: I struck twenty-two percent of all the damage against the boss, I struck the killing blow, and I had first looting choice. The crystal is mine. The man with the hawk says it was on her body and he took it first, and calls me a murderer because Bianca ate his pet. It is a memorial crystal for the goddess Apito, which is impossible, because Apito ran that party. I have a quest regarding it. I am the party leader now, briefly. Carl calls me Pony. I scream in his face.
beats.gist: Prepotente strikes the killing blow and takes a memorial crystal for the goddess Apito.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: Look at what they gave us. The Great Race, a replacement the Valtay paid for and somebody threw together in a hurry, a circuit of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up. So I tested it. Minutes after it opened, the whole loop is dust, fine as flour. No crawler goes into their maze. No mob, no NPC, no boss gets to meet anyone. You wanted a seventh floor. Build a better one.
beats.gist: Prepotente shatters the glass tunnels of the Great Race into flour, stopping all crawlers and mobs.

beats.headline: His mother's boots
beats.text: Carl asks how I really know. My mother's boots. Boots of Kiznet's Final Flight, from a minor boss just before Carl allowed her to kill herself. The description is five hundred and three percent longer than the average item's, and it tells a fairy tale: a boy in a maze where every tunnel seals behind him, resurrected and made to start over, who spends years trying to crack the walls. She played the piano for me. She was going to do it again at the talent competition. I am never going to get that back.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl about his mother's boots and a fairy tale about a boy in a maze.

beats.headline: A giant bat, single-handed
beats.text: I am in the Bahamas, as I told the cat. Carl is to read me the lore book, since there will probably be some crossover with Cuba; that is the sensible use of him. Meanwhile I flag and capture a giant bat without anyone's assistance, and the recap shows it to everyone. When the list repopulates, I am at the top of it. The cat is second. Carl is third.
beats.gist: Prepotente captures a giant bat alone and takes the top spot on the list.

beats.headline: Typos in the transcription
beats.text: Carl reads me his Bahamas book at last: an hour of it, transcribed and sent over in chat. I do not thank him. When he asks whether I am actually receiving his messages, I reply to point out the typos in his translation.
beats.gist: Carl reads Prepotente his Bahamas book for an hour and Prepotente points out the transcription typos.

beats.headline: Four squads, asleep
beats.text: I am back in the Bahamas along with four squads, which is quite unfortunate for them. If I set it up correctly, they are asleep and will remain asleep for the remainder of the floor. I am going to finish my training and proceed to the exit when it is time.
beats.gist: Prepotente is in the Bahamas with four squads who stay asleep while he finishes his training.

beats.headline: A red tinge over the Bahamas
beats.text: Carl demands to know whether the sky here has changed colour. There is a red, sunset-like tinge coming from his direction, and naturally he is involved. The zombie event killed every one of my opponents before I could get to them, and I inform him that the blood is on his hands. If he is involved, whatever happens next will be global, and not in a good way. He tells me to eat his ass. Then he calls me the smartest guy he knows. He does not want it to be local. He wants it over the whole world, and he wants ideas.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl the zombie event killed his opponents and asks for global ideas.

beats.headline: Fifty percent, then forty, then thirty-five
beats.text: Carl asks me to tell the others what I told him. I do. I have seen gated stairwell encasements break before; I once watched Lucia Mar try to teleport a stairwell, and I saw what happened to it and to the structure around it. His theory is sound. I will not risk it myself, and I am going down with my key momentarily, but I would put it at fifty percent. Perhaps forty. Katia's fumbled explanation raised the matter of spin while being sucked upward, so perhaps thirty-five. Then the quest arrives, as I said it would.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells the others his theory about gated stairwell encasements breaking and estimates a thirty-five percent chance.

beats.headline: A penance, in lieu of a killing
beats.text: A parting message, before I take the stairs. I do hope Carl and Princess Donut survive this foolish endeavour; he is an oafish brute and the dungeon would not be the same without him. Read the winning conditions carefully. The crawlers in Indonesia, the nearest land to the far side of the Earth from Havana, are in the most danger if he does not buff that demon enough. I have also decided not to kill him for letting my mother hurt herself. He was too stupid to prevent it. His penance is to help me take my revenge on the true culprits.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl to read the winning conditions and buff the demon to save crawlers in Indonesia.

beats.headline: A score to settle first
beats.text: Hello, Carl and Donut. I am above the naga border with Bianca, surveying your defences, and your enemies believe they are being surreptitious. The elves' long-range trebuchets are preparing to fire. A hundred mercenaries in the Madness's colours think they are invisible. There are tracked vehicles under camouflage netting. With no magic permitted at the outset, I am perfectly safe, thank you. Once the festivities begin, I have a score to settle with the lead producer of the Blood Hunter program. Only then will I join your military. If you are still alive.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl and Donut he will join their military after settling a score.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.
beats.gist: Prepotente kills the Naga army after they turn Miriam into a Blood Hunter programme.

beats.headline: Big Red, and a map in my head
beats.text: Carl has not brought Donut. A contingency, he says. I mention, since nobody asked, that I have a map of all of Club Vanquisher. Miriam, Bianca and I befriended a delightful guildmaster inside, and we left through a bathroom stall in the entrance temple. Perfect recall. Then I drink my Big Red, which is from Texas, where cowboys live; I may have five soda pops a day, a hard rule of my mother's. At the door he hands me a smoke grenade and asks about my acting. Soon I am on the floor in fuzzy handcuffs that do not lock. I have been caught! Oh woe!
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl he has a map of Club Vanquisher and drinks a Texas Big Red.

beats.headline: Dialling 453 for the bug god
beats.text: Katia cannot work the portal dial. It is just lights, she says. This mechanism is quite simple. Turn off automatic mode, or Carl arrives in the temple of Emberus, she in Eileithyia's, and I at the Epicure. Then the integers. Carl calls out 453. Before this I stopped to put some of the sentient blood running along the walls into a jar. At the door I say my litany of names under my breath: Miriam, and Bianca, and several others, ending on Ragazzaccia. I am ready for battle, Carl.
beats.gist: Prepotente puts sentient blood from the walls into a jar and dials 453 for the bug god.

beats.headline: Who would have thought
beats.text: Your army people are marching on the castle, Carl, and the plan is working: a large host of Madness troops has come out to face us. However, whichever one of you shot that giant rainbow into the air has attracted the other half, and they are coming to meet you. Who would have thought that such a move would alert the enemy? I suspect you are about to be in extreme danger. Now he wants me on his side of the field. I will come as requested, Carl.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells Carl that Madness troops face his army, but a giant rainbow alerted the enemy.

beats.headline: I will hug you now
beats.text: I found her. Li Na is in the woods, seeking those who got away. She appears to have new hunting skills and the ability to fly, likely a benefit of her dexterity. Curious that she cannot find those she has marked. Quite unfortunate. Carl asks if I am coming to rescue Louis. I think not. I will assist Li Na and keep him apprised. I drink a potion. Quite the day. Then I dismount, walk up to him, and inform him that I will hug him now, fellow warrior. I scream.
beats.gist: Prepotente finds Li Na in the woods and tells Carl he will hug him.

beats.headline: Out of Li Na's reach
beats.text: We did not find them. There were eighteen she marked, and three survived long enough to get away, and we now know who and where they are. It is not good news for Li Na. I drink another potion. That savage orc King Rust brought his harem into the dungeon on a deal with the AI, as non-combatants who could not be conscripted. They were caught in the ball but not as enemies, so Li Na could mark them. Three reached the Desperado Club and went through the Cosmic Lounge, back to the 18th floor. She will never heal.
beats.gist: Three of eighteen people Li Na marked survived and went through the Cosmic Lounge to the 18th floor.

beats.headline: Do not let them fall
beats.text: A warning, since nobody else has thought of it. Do not come in last, obviously. But do not kill your opponents either, and help any straggler who has fallen. The pool for each heat is fixed. Lose one team and it is fine; lose two and they must mix in the leftovers of other heats, and the leftovers may well be crawlers. I fear whole races of crawler against crawler. I chose biological, naturally. One would have to be an imbecile to have picked mechanical. Carl and the cat picked mechanical.
beats.gist: Prepotente warns against killing opponents or letting stragglers fall to avoid mixing crawlers in the heats.

beats.headline: Sweety
beats.text: Our mount is named Sweety. She is a Perriso, a large-mount mammal similar to the tapir, big enough to carry me, this oaf, and one or two mercenaries. The oaf calls her a giant elephant pig and says we should have chosen mechanical, because he is a mechanic. He did mention that before I chose. It was irrelevant. Now he is buying mystery meat from a stall with no health inspection certificate, because some foods raise a mount's speed, and I have warned him about gastrointestinal distress. I am, as ever, correct. Observe the sidewalk.
beats.gist: Prepotente names the Perriso mount Sweety and warns a mechanic about gastrointestinal distress from mystery meat.

beats.headline: A biscuit and a question about a girl
beats.text: I have a conundrum, and I bring it to the table. Three enriched biscuits came out of a celestial box, and one of them is the Paramour. Her name is Ragazzaccia. She was my girlfriend before the dungeon began, and she is still a goat; the other two biscuits would leave her one. Donut says absolutely not, and says it several times, and offers me rules to live by. She is right. It is too late. I do not have anybody else to ask these things.
beats.gist: Prepotente asks about Ragazzaccia, a goat and former girlfriend, after three enriched biscuits leave a celestial box.

beats.headline: Thrown out for outside drinks
beats.text: Celine Dion first charted in Canada in 1981, in French. Somebody in this bar had to know. I carry perhaps two hundred sodas from the diner, each with a different buff, each with its own straw, and I have told Jurgen he may eat nowhere else. The gremlin behind the counter objects to outside drinks in a drinking establishment. I scream at him. He falls over. I will not frequent an establishment where I am not wanted, so I leave it.
beats.gist: Prepotente carries two hundred diner sodas with different buffs and straws and screams at a gremlin.

beats.headline: In praise of the secretions
beats.text: Half a bottle of the bat creatures' secretions buys about thirty minutes of protection from most environments. It is a superior and versatile product, and I cannot understand why it must be drunk by hand. Louis compares the taste to something from Miami. I would not know. I had the water park tunnels entirely mapped, and now my heat is rolled into the jungle. Sweety will be most upset. Take no wrong turn in those tubes. They come quickly.
beats.gist: Prepotente drinks bat creature secretions for environmental protection while Louis compares the taste to Miami.

beats.headline: He has read up on Chachi
beats.text: The analog in your culture, since you ask, is the Aztec goddess of the same name. Benevolent, supposedly, in a civilisation that practised human sacrifice, and the origin of a flood myth because she cried for many days. It is somewhat interesting how closely these gods track your pantheons. I, too, intend to enter this guild. I will be performing "In the Air Tonight" by Phil Collins. The cat's number is a surprise and a duet, and Carl requires potions and scrolls to survive it. That sounds like a hoot.
beats.gist: Prepotente is a goat crawler who intends to enter a guild and perform In the Air Tonight.

beats.headline: A delight, this place
beats.text: Somebody must ask the only question that matters, so I ask it. How will we know? She leaves Zhang's party, and a note may never arrive. A cactus, it transpires. Keep it somewhere safe, I tell them, and it still looks to me like a surefire suicide method. Good luck, Li Na. On my way out I concede the guild has improved. Pet stables. A Bopca. I declined to attach my personal space before; perhaps now. I have a karaoke kit, bought to practise for a performance that never happened. The cat gasps.
beats.gist: Prepotente asks how they will know, gives Li Na a cactus, and sees a Bopca.

beats.headline: Sweety, rockets and a goat
beats.text: The plan is mine, and it is simple, so naturally the humans needed it explained. Once their shield is down, Bianca takes the half-mantaur out of the back of the Pontiac, delivers him to Carl, and returns to us. Sweety carries Jurgen and me through the air on her burning feet, and I put two volleys of rockets into the Dominators' car as it leaves the room. Shield is down. Bianca moves in. I do not require thanks. I require the others to keep up.
beats.gist: Prepotente uses rockets and a goat to help Bianca deliver a half-mantaur to Carl.

beats.headline: How to stop a slag elemental
beats.text: Everybody, attend. These elementals regenerate from the river, so killing them is a waste of effort, and I do not waste effort. They can, however, be delayed. It sounds counterintuitive, which is presumably why none of you thought of it: add any non-molten metal to one and it collapses at once back into the river, and must wait for that metal to melt before it can attack again. I am on the wall track with Jurgen, moving slower than I care to, and I have had time to watch. You are welcome.
beats.gist: Prepotente tells others that non-molten metal collapses slag elementals back into the river.

beats.headline: A little stinky butt
beats.text: The crystal lives around my neck, and Carl may observe it. He may not keep it. Memorial Crystal, Apito, zero per cent charged. Osvaldo wore it and it did nothing; he kept it in inventory and it did nothing; then, near the end of Faction Wars, it shone into the sky on its own. It should not exist, since Apito is not dead. My god's quest says only to hold it, and I will know when to use it. The cat asks what my mother would have called me. A little stinky butt.
beats.gist: Prepotente wears Apito, a zero per cent charged Memorial Crystal that shone into the sky.

beats.headline: His mother, had she gone
beats.text: This is my mother if she had never stayed to care for her parents. A concert pianist in New York. She would never have known me. I did not get to sing, and nobody said they were sorry. Imani did not want me in the guild. I wish I had never taken the pet biscuit. Carl tells me Miriam is alone up there, and that we are a herd. It is a crude argument. It works. I embrace him, and then I tell the oaf to drive. Carl. You may call me Pony.
beats.gist: Prepotente is a goat crawler who joins Carl's herd after Carl mentions Miriam is alone.

beats.headline: He calls it a nonevent
beats.text: The line into the Outreach Guild is gone and I believe nobody else will take a deal. Fewer than three hundred of us remain. A somber day. I have analysed Carl's plan, and I am confident this last race will be a nonevent, an anticlimax after the rest of the floor. For stating the obvious, the cat tells me, with nothing but love in her heart, to shut up, and I scream in the street. Carl assures me something horrible will happen at any moment. Then we do our good-race hug.
beats.gist: Prepotente believes the last race is a nonevent and a cat tells him to shut up.

beats.headline: Three looted vehicles and a theme
beats.text: An ice-cream truck, an airport stair truck and a battered Tundra. I looted every one of them out of somebody else's garage, and now they are ours. Our theme is Vengeance. I have ideas. Carl's plan puts gods in this arena and we do not know its size, so they may arrive huge, and we should design accordingly, and the cat is shouting about papier-mache. We do not have time for papier-mache. She has druid spells. Let her make real flowers bloom.
beats.gist: Prepotente loots an ice-cream truck, an airport stair truck, and a battered Tundra from garages.

beats.headline: In the Air Tonight
beats.text: The script called for a stinging statement about the downtrodden rising to devour those who revel in our suffering. Instead I sing. In the Air Tonight, the song I was never called up to sing at the bar, and Sweety stops dead in the judging area and pounds out the beat with her feet. The cat says I am ruining everything and that the song is about a divorce. Carl says it is appropriate. Carl is correct. Jurgen says I never tell him anything. I don't.
beats.gist: Prepotente sings In the Air Tonight, and Sweety pounds the beat with her feet.

beats.headline: The god stole my crystal
beats.text: I will recover. I was electrocuted; I am now fine. Tend to Jurgen. The deity stole my memorial crystal, pulled it right off my neck, and I have filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. It was charging up with every one of her attacks and it was our protection, and we lost any floor boss prize too. The gods are level 250. Carl says that is why we will not face them one-on-one. Then he sends me a party request.
beats.gist: Prepotente files a complaint with the Epicure after a level 250 deity stole his crystal.

relations.note: A reflected spell, ping-ponged until it turned inside out
